Direct DLQ-publish-failure coverage and the real system proof remain required.

consensus: Use the producer-owned v1 Source, Workspace, and Model HTTP/event contracts; do not add compatibility shims.

Treat authentication, nonce migration, generation fencing, event validation, and cross-service proof as merge-blocking gates.

Keep broad Knowledge administration in #23, durable deletion-consumer DLQ/replay in #46, and remaining fault/browser/container matrix work in #26.
